head_commit.message:
Complete NRB 2.0: 20 tasks, executable scoring, evidence rubrics and clearer web flows

Add three Fortran tasks, fixed-goal Lean verification, six research tasks and two chat tasks. Bind real candidate assets and separate R06 modes. Add offline evaluators, strict report validation, independent H02 browser scoring, manual review evidence, version-aware comparisons and race-safe file imports.

Verified 91 regression tests, 52 native controls, 5 release contracts, 83 frontend contracts and observed browser workflows. Preserve previous release materials and evidence; run actual Docker gates in CI.
